meta.description: Fixed-point decimal types for Go stored in an int64 — Money64 (four decimals) and Percent64 (two decimals), with string parsing and formatting and no floating point. Use when working with github.com/pablo-botella/fixed64 or when Go code needs money or percentage values that live as integers in memory and in the database.
